svg.title: Thirteen intervals on one page (phone)
svg.desc: A one-page table of the thirteen intervals from C4: each row has its identity colour, name, abbreviation, note pair, semitone count and its three Plogger marks (shape, shadow, fill), with N/A for the unison and the octave.

g.text: HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
